next.not_found: It may have been deleted or moved. Refresh and try again.
next.invalid_input: Check the values and try again.
next.io: Check that the disk is available and not full, then try again.
next.corrupt_config: Move data.json or settings.toml out of the data folder to start fresh, or restore it from a backup.
next.host_key_rejected: Connect again and accept the key if you trust this host.
next.auth_failed: Check the username and the key or password of the host.
next.unsupported: The server does not support this operation.
next.timeout: Check that the host is reachable, then try again.
next.network: Check the hostname, the port and your network, then connect again.
next.host_key_changed: Confirm the new key with the server administrator before replacing it.
next.secret_required: Enter the password or passphrase when asked, or set its secret variable.
next.keychain_unavailable: Unlock or enable the system keychain, then try again.
next.not_connected: Connect to the host, then try again.
next.busy: Wait a moment and try again.
next.permission_denied: Check the permissions of the file or folder.
next.missing_variables: Define them in the global or project variables.
next.not_text: Only UTF-8 text files can be edited here.
next.partial_write: The remote file may be damaged: save again to write it whole.
next.large_file: Confirm the download to edit it.
next.sensitive: Confirm to copy it to this computer.
next.blocked_type: Choose an editor app in Settings to edit this type of file.
next.app_not_found: Choose the editor app again in Settings.
next.app_not_editor: Choose an editor app in Settings.
next.host_changed: Stop editing it, then open it again from the current server.
next.app_failed: Check the editor app chosen in Settings.
next.not_regular_file: Only regular files can be opened in an editor.
next.not_uploaded: Upload the changes first, or stop editing and delete them.
next.import_format: Choose a file made with Export in Carapace.
next.import_version: Update Carapace, then import it again.
next.import_invalid: Fix the file or export it again.
next.import_secret_value: Remove the value from the file and set it in Variables instead.
next.unknown: Try again. Restart the app if it keeps happening.
